text.brief: On March 8, 2000, Bill Clinton told an audience at Johns Hopkins that the Party's effort to control the internet was like trying to nail Jell-O to the wall.
text.record: The House passed permanent normal trade relations 237 to 197 on May 24, 2000, and the Senate followed 83 to 15. The same act created the Congressional-Executive Commission on China to monitor human rights and the rule of law. The People's Republic joined the World Trade Organization on December 11, 2001. Economists later estimated that the surge of imports cost the United States 2.0 to 2.4 million jobs from 1999 to 2011.
text.reading: Accession ended the annual vote that had given Congress leverage each spring, and the relationship changed phase. The Party entered the host's trading system as a guest and began to shape its rules, which is Stratagem 30, while it kept the controls Clinton expected the internet to break.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The policy rested on a theory that trade would open the system, and no one set a test for when the theory had failed.
text.fix: State the outcome a trade bargain should produce, and review it on a fixed schedule with the power to change terms.
